title: ingress.v1
description: The untrusted-event ingress record. GitHub App webhooks (issues, PRs, comments) are ATTACKER-INFLUENCEABLE input: vcs-ingress verifies the X-Hub-Signature-256, persists ONE Delivery per webhook to the vcs:events stream (persist-first — a dispatch failure never loses the record; /internal/replay re-runs it), and dispatches an event.v1 envelope per matching vcs:subs subscription. NO PAYLOAD BYTES CROSS THE SEAM: the envelope carries an opaque github:// ref only, the payload itself is anchored by digest and deliberately not re-stored, and the fired agent unit re-fetches content via read-only tools. Worst case of any injection = a bad proposal.v1 in the queue (the human gate), never an action.

SourceRef.description: The OPAQUE reference to the GitHub object the delivery concerns — github://<owner>/<repo>/issues/<n> or .../pull/<n>. A cred-gated read-only tool resolves it in-container; never the bytes.

Plan.description: The plan a dispatched envelope carries — stamped from the matching subscription (the routine's authored plan), never derived from webhook content.

Envelope.description: The normalized event.v1 Event this delivery emits. The STORED form carries the shared identity fields (name, occurred_at, source); `subject` + `plan` are stamped PER SUBSCRIPTION at dispatch time, and the dispatched form must conform to event.v1 (validated by path at the agent-api seam). Opaque ref ONLY — no title/body text ever rides here.

name.description: vcs.issue.opened | vcs.issue.commented | vcs.pr.opened | vcs.pr.commented | vcs.pr.review — derived from (event, action)

subject.description: identity.v1 subject — absent in the stored record; stamped from the matching subscription at dispatch

Delivery.description: One persisted webhook delivery — the durable audit + replay record on the vcs:events stream. Only verified (signature_ok) deliveries whose (event, action) maps to a vcs.* name are persisted; a delivery with no matching subscription is persisted but not dispatched.

delivery_id.description: the X-GitHub-Delivery guid — the dedupe key (redis SET NX) and the /internal/replay/{delivery_id} handle

event.description: the raw X-GitHub-Event type (issues | issue_comment | pull_request | pull_request_review | pull_request_review_comment)

sender.description: the GitHub login that triggered the delivery — attacker-chosen, audit/display only, never an identity

signature_ok.description: X-Hub-Signature-256 verified against the raw body — always true for a persisted record (unverified deliveries are rejected 401 before persistence)

payload_digest.description: sha256 of the raw request body — the AUDIT ANCHOR: the payload is deliberately NOT re-stored (no payload bytes across the seam), so the digest is what ties this record back to what GitHub sent
